description: Members QuickRecycle patches or reaches by name. Harmony binds at runtime, so a rename in a game update would otherwise be a silent no-op instead of a build failure.

methods.name: DragControllerControlClickCallback
methods.why: the Ctrl gesture seam; prefixed to divert Ctrl+Shift to the recycler

methods.name: RefreshView
methods.why: redraws the grid after an item moves

fields.name: _magnumCargo
fields.why: reached by name via Harmony FieldRefAccess, which throws at patch time if renamed

fields.name: _magnumSpaceship
fields.why: gates on the same department check Configure uses to show the tab

methods.name: DragControllerControlClickCallback
methods.why: ArsenalScreen overrides it, so patching only the base would miss the main cargo screen

fields.name: RecyclingInProgress
fields.why: the recycler is sealed mid-batch; the sweep must refuse rather than reroute

properties.name: HasStoreConstructorDepartment
properties.why: no department means no recycling tab

methods.name: PutItemWithFallback
methods.why: same placement path DropItemInTab uses; expands the grid instead of failing

methods.name: IsQuestItem
methods.why: vanilla's own rule for what may not enter the recycling storage

properties.name: Locked
properties.why: story/quest hold; Repair refuses these too

methods.name: GetKey
methods.why: reads the Shift modifier the same way DragController does
